result.stdout:
Usage: unlimotion-cli apply --request <path|-> [--dry-run] [--tasks <path>] [--format text|json]
Preview or atomically apply an approved declarative graph request.
Required: --request
Optional: --dry-run, --tasks, --format
Defaults: dry-run=false; format=text
Allowed: request=JSON schema v1; format=text|json; repeatable: none
Effect: write unless --dry-run; exit: 0 success, 1 operation/validation failure, 2 invalid arguments
Errors: invalidArguments, notFound, preconditionFailed, conflictingOperations, descriptionMarkerConflict, businessRuleDenied, validationFailed, idempotencyConflict, reconciliationRequired, outcomeUnknown, operationFailed
Common task-source errors: invalidArguments, settingsNotFound, settingsPathMissing, settingsInvalid, settingsUnsupported, operationFailed
Example: unlimotion-cli apply --request request.json --dry-run --format json
Run apply schema/example for syntax. Request text is capped at 4 MiB. Status transitions obey graph rules; terminal status needs justification and absolute evidence links. ETags guard writes. Request hash includes decoded JSON whitespace. Receipt identifies a prior application, while desired state alone does not prove history. Preview before write; after uncertain outcome use apply inspect and read-back. For a create whose generated ID might be lost, use an apply request with a createTask operation and chosen newTaskId.
